title: Japan Regional Wage Data (by occupation and administrative level)

admin_code.description: JIS X 0401 2-digit prefecture code, zero-padded ('01'..'47'), or the synthetic national code 'JP-NAT'. Unlike China's macro-regions, every admin_level=1 code here IS a real, codified administrative unit -- Japan has no synthetic aggregate codes below national.

admin_level.description: 0 = national total (MHLW/e-Stat aggregate, code 'JP-NAT'). 1 = prefecture (47 units, JIS X 0401 2-digit code). No municipality-level wage data exists (see README section 7 / report Sec 4), so this schema does not define admin_level=2.

region_block.description: MIC's (総務省) 類型Ⅰ 10-block grouping from the 'Guideline on Regional Presentation' (地域別表章に関するガイドライン'). This is explicitly NOT a single legally-unified regional standard -- it is MIC's own recommended typology among several competing ones (e-Stat's own 社会・人口統計体系 typology, Cabinet Office's 地域区分A/B/C, etc.). See https://www.soumu.go.jp/main_content/000872772.pdf.

occupation_category.description: 'Total' for aggregate rows; one of the 12 JSOC (日本標準職業分類) Rev.5 major-group English labels when occupation_level='major'; a detailed occupation's English label when occupation_level='detailed'.
enum: Carrying, cleaning, packaging, and related workers
Elementary and junior high school teachers

occupation_code.description: JSOC major-group letter A-L when occupation_level='major'; blank/null for 'Total' or for detailed occupations (the detailed 職種（特掲） list is not letter-coded in the source tables, only ordered by row).

occupation_level.description: 'total' = the Total/all-occupations aggregate row (参考表1). 'major' = one of the 12 JSOC major groups (表２). 'detailed' = one of the ~145 detailed occupations (表３).

wage_unit.description: All wage-structure-survey figures in this module are monthly, denominated in thousands of yen (千円), except annual_special_cash_earnings which is a yearly total but still expressed in 千円 units (see wage_measure).

wage_measure.description: contractual_cash_earnings = きまって支給する現金給与額 (includes overtime). scheduled_cash_earnings = 所定内給与額 (excludes overtime) -- this is the figure MHLW calls '賃金' in its headline commentary. annual_special_cash_earnings = 年間賞与その他特別給与額 (bonuses, previous calendar year). These three series measure different things and must never be averaged together.

parent_admin_code.description: 'JP-NAT' for prefecture rows; blank/null for the national row itself.

classification_system.description: JIS_X_0401 tags the admin_code's coding standard (prefecture rows). JSOC_MAJOR / JSOC_DETAILED tag the occupation_code/occupation_category's coding standard, per Japan Standard Occupational Classification Rev.5. A single row may need only one of these populated depending on what it's keyed on; national Total rows may leave this blank.

data_availability.description: Honesty flag marking the finest level at which this row's figure is genuinely published. Japan has no macro_region-only wage data (unlike China) and no municipality-level wage data at all (see README section 7) -- 'not_available' rows document that gap rather than guessing.
